name: JSON Preview
description: Tree-style JSON preview with node folding, JSONPath extraction, metadata analysis, syntax colors, error locations, duplicate-key hints, JSON Lines support and format/minify/validate commands.
author: yyn0210

commands.label: JSON: Preview
commands.description: Open or refresh the JSON preview

commands.label: JSON: Toggle Fold
commands.description: Fold or expand the object or array containing the cursor

commands.label: JSON: Fold All
commands.description: Collapse every nested object and array in the preview

commands.label: JSON: Expand All
commands.description: Expand every folded object and array in the preview

commands.label: JSON: Toggle Fold All
commands.description: Fold or expand every nested container from the preview toolbar

commands.label: JSON: Show JSONPath
commands.description: Show the JSONPath of the value at the cursor

commands.label: JSON: Extract JSONPath
commands.description: Evaluate the selected JSONPath expression, or the configured one, in the inspector

commands.label: JSON: JSONPath at Cursor or Selection
commands.description: Show the path at the cursor, or extract the selected JSONPath expression

commands.label: JSON: Metadata
commands.description: Analyze value counts, depth, duplicate keys, strings and numbers

commands.label: JSON: Validate
commands.description: Check the active document and report JSON problems

settings.label: Indent width
settings.description: Spaces per nesting level in the preview and in formatted documents.

settings.label: Sort keys in the preview
settings.description: Sort object keys alphabetically in the preview only. Formatting keeps the original order.

settings.label: Preview JSON Lines
settings.description: When the document is not a single JSON value, preview each non-empty line as one record if every line is valid JSON.

settings.label: Initial fold level
settings.description: 0 expands everything. 1 keeps only the root expanded, 2 also keeps its direct containers expanded, and so on.

settings.label: Show JSONPath on preview lines
settings.description: Append the JSONPath of each value to its preview line.

settings.label: JSONPath expression
settings.description: Used by JSON: Extract JSONPath when no text is selected.

zh-CN.name: JSON 预览
zh-CN.description: 树形 JSON 预览：节点折叠、JSONPath 提取、元数据分析、语法着色、错误定位、重复键提示、JSON Lines 支持，以及格式化/压缩/校验命令。

json.preview.label: JSON：预览
json.preview.description: 打开或刷新 JSON 预览

json.fold.toggle.label: JSON：折叠/展开
json.fold.toggle.description: 折叠或展开光标所在的对象或数组

json.fold.all.label: JSON：全部折叠
json.fold.all.description: 折叠预览中的所有嵌套对象和数组

json.fold.none.label: JSON：全部展开
json.fold.none.description: 展开预览中所有已折叠的对象和数组

json.fold.toggle-all.label: JSON：切换全部折叠
json.fold.toggle-all.description: 从预览工具栏折叠或展开所有嵌套容器

json.path.extract.label: JSON：提取 JSONPath
json.path.extract.description: 在检查器中求值选中的 JSONPath 表达式，或配置的表达式

json.path.action.label: JSON：光标处或选区的 JSONPath
json.path.action.description: 显示光标处的路径，或提取选中的 JSONPath 表达式

json.metadata.label: JSON：元数据
json.metadata.description: 分析值的数量、深度、重复键、字符串和数字

json.format.label: JSON：格式化文档
json.format.description: 美化当前 JSON 文档

json.minify.label: JSON：压缩文档
json.minify.description: 压缩当前 JSON 文档

json.validate.label: JSON：校验
json.validate.description: 检查当前文档并报告 JSON 问题

indent.label: 缩进宽度
indent.description: 预览和格式化文档中每层嵌套的空格数。

sort_keys.label: 预览中排序键
sort_keys.description: 仅在预览中按字母顺序排列对象键；格式化保留原始顺序。

json_lines.label: 预览 JSON Lines
json_lines.description: 当文档不是单个 JSON 值时，如果每一行都是有效 JSON，则把每个非空行预览为一条记录。

fold_level.label: 初始折叠层级
fold_level.description: 0 表示全部展开。1 只展开根，2 还展开其直接容器，依此类推。

show_paths.label: 在预览行显示 JSONPath
show_paths.description: 在每个值的预览行后附加其 JSONPath。

jsonpath.label: JSONPath 表达式
jsonpath.description: 未选中文本时，由「JSON：提取 JSONPath」使用。
